verdict.rationale: Slack does document official export tools for workspace data (slack-docs-22/23/35/36), which nominally support the compliance-export story, but community evidence directly contradicts free/easy access: Corporate Export of DMs and private channels requires legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval, and users questioned whether migrating years of full message history out of Slack is even feasible under these restrictions. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of a machine-readable format spec (JSON/CSV schema details), no evidence addressing the approval-gate friction, and no independent confirmation that large-scale/private-channel exports actually work in practice.
